call_style: fresh isolated interpreter with only reviewed v2 source directory supplying projection/comparison/shadow modules; parent separately gates reads and watches whole invocation
events: list of exactly six dictionaries, each with exact event_input_fields; three representations are bytes, not paths

event_input_fields.event_id: string, unique, raw identity supplied privately
event_input_fields.original_t0_us: required int valid UTC microseconds or null; independently census-bound
event_input_fields.body_pins: exact three members each bytes:int and sha256:hex64

result_fields.events: six event results in original supplied order
result_fields.aggregate: aggregate counts, eighteen representation slots, six event denominator

event_result_fields.preserved_original_T0_us: independently supplied int or null, never inferred from own clock
event_result_fields.catalogue_drift: compare original QML vs fresh QML
event_result_fields.representation_difference: compare fresh QML vs native SCML
event_result_fields.input_body_pins: copy of exact three supplied sha256/bytes pins

comparison_count_scopes.newly_unique_reference_object_count: distinct left qualifying arrival-referenced IDs gaining a unique right object across all networks
comparison_count_scopes.newly_resolved_reference_count: distinct left qualifying arrival-referenced IDs newly accepted across all networks
comparison_count_scopes.newly_accepted_NZ_reference_count: newly accepted all-network qualifying-reference IDs intersect right accepted NZ subset; XX to NZ already accepted is zero
comparison_count_scopes.content_matched_resolution_candidate_cou: newly_resolved count across ALL NETWORKS gated by content and absence of known revision conflict
comparison_count_scopes.paired_recorded_revision_resolution_coun: newly_resolved count across ALL NETWORKS gated by content plus matching recorded revision evidence

independent_semantic_auditor_equality_li: producer guarded counters are all-network; an auditor guarding NZ subset has a different declared scope. Never assert universal field equality. Unrecognized native boolean policy and numeric geometry policy also require explicit alignment.
clock_semantics: station_count counts accepted subset, not unobserved complete network; NZ_coverage_known/incomplete flags distinguish unresolved structure. t0_us is own earliest accepted subset; anchor_us is own or independently preserved clock; strict counts use string keys 1/3/5 and < deadline with no nonnegative-delay filter. No operational latency claim.
whole_invocation_errors: invalid input/pin/bounds or >8MiB output raises ValueError; no partial output promoted; parent retains independent failure receipt and all 18 input pins
